channel.title: Sweet Melodies News
channel.description: Ghana news from Sweet Melodies FM 94.3 FM

item.title: Mahama urges churches to protect vulnerable people at Accra congress
item.description: President John Dramani Mahama has called on church leaders at the World Assemblies of God Congress to turn faith into practical community service.

item.title: Hearts of Oak Prepare for Vision FC Following Port City Win
item.description: Coach Nebojsa Kapor calls on supporters as Vision FC aim to end a five-match winless streak.

item.title: Brazil Senate Approves Shorter Workweek Ahead of Runoff Election
item.description: A new Quaest poll shows Flavio Bolsonaro with a slight lead over President Lula in Brazil’s presidential race.

item.title: Assemblies of God loans 10,000-seater dome for Ghana at 70 celebrations
item.description: Shipping delays from Dubai prevented the church from using the facility for its ongoing global congress in Accra.

item.title: Black Queens Name Lineup For Olympic Qualifier Against Mauritius
item.description: Coach Kim Lars Björkegren urges improved finishing as Ghana hosts Mauritius in an LA 2028 Olympic qualifying match.

item.title: Archaeologists find world’s oldest shipwreck off Turkish coast
item.description: Ceramic jars from a 4,700-year-old Bronze Age vessel reveal ancient Mediterranean trade routes.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV recovers in hospital after successful lung cancer surgery
item.description: The 71-year-old pontiff is walking and eating following an operation in Rome to remove a cancerous lung lobe.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV rests in Rome hospital following lung cancer surgery
item.description: Doctors removed part of the 71-year-old pontiff’s right lung during a 90-minute operation at Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday.

item.title: Netflix cuts 1,000 global jobs as streaming growth slows
item.description: The streaming service is cutting roughly six per cent of its global staff as competition from free video platforms increases.

item.title: KNUST announces new reopening dates for 2026 academic year
item.description: Freshmen arrive in Kumasi on Thursday, 15 October, while continuing students return on Saturday ahead of Monday lectures.

item.title: GRA Clarifies Digital VAT System Will Not Add New Tax
item.description: Tax officials confirm that 92 streaming platforms already charge the levy, while 100 newly identified foreign services will be added gradually.

item.title: Fire at Mallam GRIDCo substation disrupts power in parts of Accra
item.description: Electricity supply is returning to parts of Accra after an early morning fire damaged a major transformer at the Mallam substation.

item.title: Nana Fitz urges GFA and Sports Ministry not to rush Black Stars appointment
item.description: The sports administrator says football leaders must take time when selecting the next head coach for the national team.

item.title: Donald Trump announces plans for resource exploration in Greenland
item.description: The US president says large-scale searching for oil, gas and minerals will begin in the Arctic territory.

item.title: Ghana Premier League title race opens up after decline of top clubs
item.description: Football analyst Dennis Nyaku says slumping performances from Accra Hearts of Oak and Asante Kotoko have widened competition across the national league.

item.title: GoldBod refines up to 90 per cent of gold in Ghana, CEO tells Parliament
item.description: The Ghana Gold Board has recovered GH¢38.7 million in debts while expanding local jobs through 24-hour refinery operations.

item.title: Ghana delegation attends IMF World Bank meetings in Bangkok
item.description: Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson and Central Bank Governor Johnson Asiama are courting global investors ahead of the 2027 budget.

item.title: Black Maidens Receive Integrity Briefing Before FIFA U-17 World Cup
item.description: Ghana’s national under-17 women’s team has been educated on match-fixing risks ahead of their global tournament.

item.title: GTEC orders public universities to reopen by October 16
item.description: The Education Ministry directs public universities to resume lectures on October 19 as government moves to resolve administrators’ strike.

item.title: GFA fines Bibiani Gold Stars over CEO misconduct
item.description: The Ghana Football Association penalised the Western North club GH¢5,000 following an incident involving CEO Kwasi Adu during a match against Hearts of Oak.

item.title: IMF raises Ghana 2026 growth forecast to 5.7 percent
item.description: Lower inflation projections offer potential relief for household budgets, transport costs and local trading across all regions of Ghana.

item.title: Black Queens arrive in Takoradi for Olympic qualifier against Mauritius
item.description: Ghana’s women’s national team holds a 3-0 lead heading into the second leg match at Essipong Stadium.

item.title: Drone attacks sink commercial ship off Bulgaria in Black Sea
item.description: A second vessel was damaged in Black Sea strikes, raising concerns over vital trade lanes that supply grain to global markets.

item.title: Ghana U17 team targets semi-finals ahead of Benin clash
item.description: A victory against Benin will guarantee the Black Starlets a place in the last four of the WAFU Zone B Championship.

item.title: Black Queens host Mauritius in Olympic qualifier at reopened Essipong Stadium
item.description: Ghana holds a 3-0 advantage heading into the second leg of the 2028 Olympic qualifier in Sekondi-Takoradi.

item.title: Moody’s upgrades Ghana credit rating to B3 with stable outlook
item.description: Lower domestic borrowing costs and high gold export prices helped drive the rating upgrade for the nation.

item.title: Hearts of Oak coach Nebojsa Kapor criticises pitch quality in Ghana
item.description: Accra Hearts of Oak manager Nebojsa Kapor says poor playing surfaces across Ghana remain a major hurdle for national football development.

item.title: REFFA 2026 announces nominees with 314 entries from 36 countries
item.description: The pan-African film festival targets global visibility for African cinema after receiving entries from 36 countries.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo surgery in Rome for lung nodule
item.description: The 71-year-old leader of the Catholic Church will enter hospital on Tuesday after doctors found a small lesion during a checkup.

item.title: Kumasi market fires prompt emergency service call for new equipment
item.description: Firefighters save dozens of shops at Aboabo Market while fire officials warn that ageing vehicles threaten emergency responses in Kumasi.

item.title: Ghana beat Togo 1-0 in WAFU Zone B U17 opener
item.description: Midfielder David Kwarteng scored the early winning goal to place the Black Starlets top of Group A in Burkina Faso.

item.title: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson leads delegation to IMF meetings in Bangkok
item.description: Ghana is seeking foreign investment for jobs and infrastructure after transitioning from a 3 billion dollar IMF bailout to a non-financing policy agreement.

item.title: Medeama stay top of Ghana Premier League as Kotoko fall to All Blacks
item.description: Matchday six results saw Hearts of Oak, Bechem United and Berekum Chelsea secure victories on Sunday, 11 October 2026.

item.title: Agyinasare cautions Ghanaians against culture of lies
item.description: The Christian leader says dishonesty has turned into a regular habit for many people across the country.

item.title: Davido praises John Mahama after church video goes viral
item.description: The Nigerian musician commended the Ghanaian leader’s humility after watching a trending video of him dancing in church.

item.title: DVLA adds six local languages to driving theory test system
item.description: Applicants across Ghana can now take their driving examination in Twi, Ga, Ewe, Dagbani, Nzema or Hausa.

item.title: Ghana faces morning mist and evening thunderstorms on Monday 12 October
item.description: The Ghana Meteorological Agency warns drivers of poor morning visibility and advises residents in northern and middle sectors to prepare for wet weather.

item.title: Public basic schools resume classes across Ghana as teachers suspend strike
item.description: Pre-tertiary teacher unions suspend their nationwide strike following agreements with government over promotion arrears and allowances.

item.title: Ghana to appoint interim coaches for Black Stars AFCON qualifiers
item.description: An interim technical team will take charge of the national football squad for upcoming continental qualifying matches.

item.title: Majid Michel’s elder sister celebrates actor as family’s biggest star
item.description: The elder sister of Ghanaian actor Majid Michel has praised him for achieving great success despite being the youngest sibling.

item.title: Donald Trump announces Russia Ukraine energy ceasefire deal
item.description: The United States chief eases Russian sanctions to cut global fuel prices while demanding new leadership in Ukraine.

item.title: US seeks talks with Ghana to review rejected health compact
item.description: Washington wants discussions to modify or strip disputed clauses from a proposed 109 million dollar health funding package.

item.title: UG and KNUST postpone 2026/2027 academic year reopening over GAUA strike
item.description: Public universities in Accra and Kumasi delay campus resumption indefinitely as administrator strike actions disrupt operations.

item.title: Medeama SC maintain Ghana Premier League lead as Hearts of Oak win
item.description: Medeama SC opened a three-point lead at the top of the Ghana Premier League table after matchday six victories.

item.title: Finance officials gather in Bangkok for IMF and World Bank annual meetings
item.description: Global economic risks, rising debt burdens, and war will focus discussions at the annual financial gathering in Thailand.

item.title: Ghana defeat Togo to lead WAFU Zone B U17 tournament
item.description: David Kwarteng scored early as the Black Starlets secured three points in Ouagadougou.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery in Rome
item.description: Catholic leader Pope Leo XIV confirms doctors caught a lung growth early and expects to recover within a week.

item.title: Nepal evacuates northern villages as flash flood destroys buildings
item.description: Villagers along the Budhi Gandaki river are urged to move to safety after a landslide triggers severe flooding.

item.title: ECG announces planned Accra power cuts as Ashanti fault causes outages
item.description: Maintenance work in Greater Accra will cause eight-hour outages from 11 to 16 October while engineers repair a bulk supply point in Ashanti.

item.title: UN expert urges Ghana to strengthen Rent Control Department against rent hikes
item.description: A United Nations housing envoy says equipping rent regulators will protect low-income families from soaring housing costs in urban areas.
